candidates.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
verified_facts: Independent ground-truth points are surveyed on flat unambiguous surfaces.
Each ground-truth point has +/-3 cm RMSE accuracy.
Ground truth is used to assess LiDAR RMSE, standard deviation and random error.
semantic_limits: Ground-truth point accuracy is not the same as parcel-level terrain-model accuracy.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue point density FAQ
verified_facts: 1 m DSM surveys target at least 1 point per square metre average density.
50 cm targets 4 ppsqm and 25 cm targets 16 ppsqm.
Point density varies across the scan and is not raster resolution.
semantic_limits: DTM density under vegetation may be lower than DSM density.

candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy FAQ
verified_facts: Absolute height error specification is less than +/-15 cm RMSE.
Relative random height error is expected to be no more than +/-5 cm.
semantic_limits: These are survey specifications, not parcel-specific 95% confidence intervals.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 1m
verified_facts: Dataset CRS is EPSG:27700.
Vertical accuracy is +/-15 cm RMSE.
WMS, WCS, WMTS and survey-index metadata services are exposed.
semantic_limits: Service availability does not prove a specific parcel sample was executed.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2m
verified_facts: Dataset CRS is EPSG:27700.
Vertical accuracy is +/-15 cm RMSE.
Coverage metadata and survey-index services are available.
semantic_limits: 2 m data remains a cross-check, not the primary parcel result.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DSM 2m
verified_facts: Dataset CRS is EPSG:27700.
DSM service and survey-index metadata are published.
DSM is a surface model rather than bare-earth terrain.
semantic_limits: DSM is excluded from the primary ground-height result.

candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: Available at 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m depending on survey.
GeoTIFF data is supplied in 5 km zip files.
Metadata records survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model.
semantic_limits: Timestamped DSM includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation.

candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: DTM removes surface objects using algorithms and manual editing.
GeoTIFF rasters are supplied in 5 km zip files.
Data is aligned to OS Grid and referenced to Newlyn.
semantic_limits: Historical transformation is survey-period specific and must be explicit.

candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme survey products
verified_facts: Products are supplied as 5 km tiles aligned to OS Grid.
Point cloud is LAZ; surface models are GeoTIFF.
Index catalogues provide survey-specific tile metadata.
semantic_limits: Product packaging and classification do not by themselves validate parcel sampling.

candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: Coverage metadata is available through download, WMS and WFS.
Dataset reference period extends through 18 April 2024.
Point-cloud coverage metadata is separable from raster sample evidence.
semantic_limits: Point cloud is lineage evidence unless separately sampled under a reproducible contract.

candidates.name: ASCII to GeoTIFF delivery FAQ
verified_facts: Composite products moved from ASCII to GeoTIFF.
GeoTIFF files are supplied in 5 km tiles with elevations in metres.
GeoTIFF enables web services including WCS.
semantic_limits: Changing file format does not increase elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 grid data specification
verified_facts: 5 m grid heights represent mean heights across each 5 m pixel.
Values are positioned at pixel centres.
Each 5 km tile contains 1000 by 1000 pixels and height values are given to 0.01 m.
semantic_limits: 0.01 m storage precision is not measurement accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 per-tile metadata specification
verified_facts: Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI.
Metadata identifies the 5 km National Grid tile reference.
Metadata records projected and vertical reference systems.
semantic_limits: OS Terrain 5 remains secondary sanity evidence for this sub-metre workflow.

candidates.name: OSGB36 / British National Grid EPSG:27700
verified_facts: EPSG:27700 is a projected CRS for OSGB36 / British National Grid.
Axes are easting and northing in metres.
Scope includes engineering survey and topographic mapping.
semantic_limits: Horizontal CRS definition is separate from vertical datum definition.

candidates.name: ODN height EPSG:5701
verified_facts: EPSG:5701 is the ODN height vertical CRS.
Its scope includes geodesy and engineering survey.
semantic_limits: Vertical CRS identity does not reduce LiDAR source RMSE.

candidates.name: OSGB36 / British National Grid + ODN height EPSG:7405
verified_facts: EPSG:7405 is a valid compound CRS.
It combines EPSG:27700 horizontal coordinates with ODN height.
Scope includes engineering survey and topographic mapping.
semantic_limits: Compound CRS correctness does not substitute for source lineage and sampling proof.
